title: feature list
description: e-designer's switchable features and whether each is on on this machine, from get features; enable feature and disable feature answer it too. The board reads it to close what is switched off, so the page and the server name the same features.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always FeatureList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Every feature, in the order the app lists them.

items.description: One feature e-designer can switch, and whether it is on on this machine.

id.description: The feature's id, which enable feature and disable feature take.

covers.description: What the feature covers, in words for people, so a reader says what switching it off closes.

needs.description: The values the feature needs to run, so switching it on can name each one missing; absent when it needs none.

items.description: One value a feature needs, such as an environment variable or a settings row.

name.description: The value's name, as it is set.

purpose.description: What the feature needs it for, in words for people.

startsOff.description: True for a feature that is off until switched on (ADR-E9), so a reader says why it is off on a new machine; absent when it starts on.

on.description: True when nothing closes the feature, so its routes and controls are open.

by.description: What closed it: switch, the owner's disable feature; absent while it is on. An open word, so a later closer (public mode, a license) needs no new contract.

missing.description: The values the feature needs that are not set, so a feature that is on but cannot run says why; absent when none is missing.

items.description: One value a feature needs, such as an environment variable or a settings row.

name.description: The value's name, as it is set.

purpose.description: What the feature needs it for, in words for people.
